claim: The declared canonical dataset contains 45 buildings, 36 eligible buildings and 630 unordered two-building candidates.
allowed_wording: The defined 630-candidate universe was exhaustively screened by the rule-based 2.5D procedure.
forbidden_wording: The AI found the globally optimal real-world design.
notes: Exhaustiveness is conditional on the declared eligibility and pairwise intervention universe.

claim: The 2.5D low-area-drop ranking agrees with HB-Radiance on the frozen independent N=20 sample.
allowed_wording: Report this as within-independent-sample metric agreement.
forbidden_wording: The proxy is universally accurate or has 99.7% accuracy for arbitrary geometries.
notes: Do not generalize beyond the frozen sample, geometry family and metric.

claim: The four-term composite ranking was checked against HB-Radiance on the same frozen independent sample using predeclared weights and fixed 630-universe normalization bounds.
forbidden_wording: The composite result proves global recall or universal ranking validity.
notes: No weights were fitted to the independent HB outcomes.

claim: HB-Radiance was used selectively: 23 rule candidates were verified from the 630 screened candidates, while the 20 independent scenes were research-only validation evidence.
allowed_wording: State the selective high-fidelity design explicitly.
notes: The 630-scene HB time is a serial-equivalent extrapolation only.

claim: The 630-candidate screening was reproduced after score/config migration with unchanged candidate IDs, scores, ranks, Top-10 and Pareto membership.
allowed_wording: Use this as a regression result, not as a new performance claim.
forbidden_wording: The old values were hard-coded to match the paper.
notes: The audit preserves any future real changes instead of forcing historical values.

claim: Design translation can change the desirability of a rule candidate; the current design ledger retains a human review step.
evidence: results_csv/138_最终候选规则与设计转译对比.csv; design_translation_summary.csv
allowed_wording: Describe the algorithm as decision support with human-in-the-loop review.
forbidden_wording: The algorithmic candidate is automatically buildable, legal, heritage-approved, safe or optimal.
notes: Architectural acceptance remains outside this computational screen.

claim: The method is a deterministic rule-based computational screening workflow, not a trained ML/LLM model.
allowed_wording: Describe the contribution as an auditable AI-assisted/product workflow if desired, but do not claim learned AI.
forbidden_wording: A trained model learned the weights or replaced designers.
notes: No training set or learned parameters are claimed.

claim: The runtime table distinguishes measured per-scene HB time, operational scenes, research-only independent scenes and serial-equivalent 630-scene extrapolation.
forbidden_wording: The 630-scene HB run took the extrapolated duration.
notes: Operational batch elapsed time remains NOT_MEASURED.

claim: Forbidden wording: 99.7% accuracy, universal accuracy, Radiance as ground truth, all-630 HB, AI beats human, global optimum, or proven buildability/legal/heritage compliance.
allowed_wording: Do not use these claims in the paper, abstract, figure captions or presentation.
